title: Ingest and Correlate Application Traces with OpenTelemetry
objectives: Ingest and Correlate Application Traces with OpenTelemetry
Verify real recorded events, retained failures and current operational evidence.

tasks.instruction: Open Recorded integration operations → OpenTelemetry. The source defines an OTLP receiver and both fictional HEC exporters, but only logs are enabled in service.pipelines. One actual correlated log has been accepted; two explicit root/child spans remain pending. Inspect the retained missing-pipeline failures.

Add service.pipelines.traces with receivers: [otlp], processors: [batch] and exporters: [splunk_hec/traces]. Preserve the existing logs pipeline and supplied virtual token/exporter. Stage the source, activate the offline adapter, then poll once. Verify pending=0 and all three signal records have actual indexed event IDs. Retry and confirm no duplicates. This is a normalized offline signal fixture, not OTLP/protobuf, an APM backend or a running Collector process.

Search index=traces OR index=app_logs | stats count dc(span_id) as spans by trace_id and inspect the job. Expect one trace with count=3 and two distinct span IDs. Independently inspect the child span with parent_span_id=1111111111111111 and follow the shared trace_id into the log.

hints: Inspect running source and actual receipts before changing configuration.
Use the paused fixture clock deliberately; verify results through a separate view or query.
